question: Which offices may read the training registrations, completions, certifications and session details (meeting access codes, budgets, accommodation) of other members of an organization, and may a member see a session they are not registered for?
decision: A member reads their own records and the public fields of sessions offered to them. The education officer and admins read all registrations and completions. Meeting access codes are shown only to registered attendees; budgets and accommodation details only to the education officer and admins.
